responsibility: Accept database landing snapshots into committed Bronze using the GB volume profile.

interfaces.output: Bronze Parquet + erl_protocol.manifests.IngestionManifest, written last as commit.

invariants: Verify landing checksum before processing; reuse completed deliveries.
Apply Bronze contract and version-aware duplicate detection; never overwrite committed parts.
external_resources: Glue 5.0 / Spark 3.5, S3 landing/Bronze/manifests/tmp, unit artifact prefix, CloudWatch; IAM supplied by Terraform.
state_and_effects: Reads landing, writes immutable Bronze and ingestion manifests; deletes only temporary output. No direct database access.

lifecycle.build: Offline build_artifacts.py --unit glue/extract-liquidez; own job.py/lib.zip plus selected protocol modules.
lifecycle.deploy: Own immutable script/library keys and Glue definition in project dev Terraform state; deploy only with jobs idle.
lifecycle.rollback: Rebuild/test this unit from the selected Git commit and deploy its compatible pair; does not revert data/schema/state.
lifecycle.remove: Remove routing/callers and own Terraform job/artifacts under approval; preserve shared IAM, buckets, contracts and committed data used by other units.

effective_scope: Owner-selected name; retains the GB-profile routing for fund_ops, portfolio_risk and exposure_compliance registers/limits. Not exclusive to the liquidity domain and does not query source databases directly.
